properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued October 22 at 12:14PM MDT until October 23 at 9:00PM MDT by NWS Billings MT
properties.description:
The National Weather Service in Billings has issued a Red Flag
Warning...which is in effect from noon to 9 PM MDT Friday.

* IMPACTS: Low humidities, unseasonably warm temperatures, strong
gusty winds, and a wind shift with a cold front will create
erratic fire behavior and difficult control of new or existing
fires.

* AFFECTED AREA:
In North Central WY Fire Zone...274.
In Southeast MT Fire Zone...131.
In Southeast MT and Northwest SD Fire Zone...133.

* COUNTIES AFFECTED:
In North Central WY...Sheridan.
In Northwest SD...Harding.
In South Central MT...Big Horn.
In Southeast MT...Carter...Fallon...Powder River...Rosebud
Treasure.

The most dangerous conditions are expected along and southeast of
a Baker Montana to Sheridan Wyoming line.

* COLD FRONT: Late afternoon into early evening.

* WIND: Southwest 20 to 30 mph with gusts up to 45 mph. Winds
shifting to the northwest behind the cold front, with continued
gusts up to 45 mph through late Friday night.

* HUMIDITY: 15 to 25 percent.

* TEMPERATURES: 75 to 85 degrees.
properties.instruction:
A Red Flag Warning means that critical fire weather conditions are
either occurring now, or will shortly. A combination of strong
winds, low relative humidity, and warm temperatures can contribute
to extreme fire behavior.

properties.headline: Red Flag Warning issued October 22 at 10:44AM MDT until October 23 at 11:00PM MDT by NWS Rapid City SD
properties.description:
...RED FLAG WARNING IN EFFECT FROM 11 AM TO 11 PM MDT FRIDAY DUE TO
GUSTY WINDS AND LOW RELATIVE HUMIDITY FOR NORTHERN CAMPBELL, SOUTHERN
CAMPBELL, CROOK COUNTY PLAINS, AND WESTON COUNTY PLAINS...

.Warm temperatures, humidities as low as 13%, and southwest winds
gusting to 50 mph ahead of an approaching cold front will create
widespread critical fire weather conditions Friday afternoon through
Friday evening. Southwest winds increase over northeastern Wyoming
after 10 am Friday morning with sustained winds of 25 to 35 mph and
gusts of 40 to 50 mph through the afternoon. Winds will shift to the
northwest after midnight as the front moves through. While some
showers may accompany the front, not expecting any widespread wetting
rains.

The National Weather Service in Rapid City SD has issued a Red Flag
Warning in effect from 11 AM to 11 PM MDT Friday.

* TIMING...From 11 AM to 11 PM MDT Friday.

* WINDS...Southwest winds 25 to 35 mph with gusts up to 50 mph.

* RELATIVE HUMIDITY...As low as 13 percent.

* IMPACTS...Any fires that develop will spread rapidly. Outdoor
burning is not recommended.
